def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two 4x5 binary panels around the 4 separator as color 3."""
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(value == 4 for value in row))
    upper = grid[:sep]
    lower = grid[sep + 1:]
    return [[3 if a != 0 or b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(top, bottom)]
            for top, bottom in zip(upper, lower)]
